\bIn the Verdanturf Battle Tent,\nthere is one crucial rule that must\nbe obeyed.
\bTrainers are permitted only to switch\ntheir POKéMON in and out.
\bTrainers are otherwise forbidden to\ncommand their POKéMON.
\bThe POKéMON are to behave according\nto their nature and battle on their own.
\bYou must put your trust in your\nPOKéMON and watch over them.
\bIf you achieve the honor of beating\nthree Trainers in succession,\nwe will present you with a prize.
\bIf you want to interrupt your challenge,\nplease save the game.
\bIf you don't save before interrupting,\nyou will be disqualified.
